 The Patriots will take on the Dolphins at 4:25 p.m. ET on Sunday, one of 12 games to be played.
 Here is the full slate:
 1 p.m. ET 
 Baltimore Ravens (4-3) at Buffalo Bills (5-1) | CBS 
Tennessee Titans (1-6) at Cincinnati Bengals (4-2) | CBS 
Arizona Cardinals (2-5) at Dallas Cowboys (3-4) | FOX 
Minnesota Vikings (6-0) at Detroit Lions (4-2) | FOX 
Indianapolis Colts (2-5) at Jacksonville Jaguars (4-2) | CBS 
Las Vegas Raiders (3-4) at New York Jets (2-5) | FOX 
Cleveland Browns (5-2) at Pittsburgh Steelers (5-2) | CBS 
Atlanta Falcons (3-4) at Tampa Bay Buccaneers (2-5) | FOX 
 4:05 p.m. ET 
 Los Angeles Chargers (0-6) at Los Angeles Rams (3-4). | FOX 
 4:25 p.m. ET 
 Kansas City Chiefs (5-1) at Denver Broncos (5-2) | CBS 
 8:20 p.m. ET 
 Philadelphia Eagles (2-5) at Washington Commanders (1-4-1) | NBC
